projectDescription: A fully client-side, multimodal satellite imagery analysis platform powered by Gemini Vision that enables conversational querying, bi-temporal change detection, and bounding-box grounding over GeoTIFF, SAR, and optical imagery.
keyFeatures: Conversational ChatGPT-style interface for satellite imagery analysis
Bi-temporal change detection by uploading Pre-event and Post-event image pairs
In-browser GeoTIFF and SAR image decoding using geotiff.js with auto-contrast
Bounding box canvas overlays for detected features (water bodies, urban areas, etc.)
Interactive CesiumJS globe map for selecting geographic regions and sending captures to chat
Zero-backend architecture — all inference runs via direct Gemini API calls from the browser
Multi-model fallback chain across multiple Gemini model versions
Persistent multi-session chat history stored with localforage
Optional GeoChat Gradio backend integration for specialist geospatial models
Drag-and-drop image upload supporting GeoTIFF, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, BigEarth, JP2, SAR
publicApiSurface: ImageMetadata, BoundingBox, EvidenceItem, ExecutionStep, ExecutionTrace, ChangeResult, OpticalSarResult, AnalysisResponse, SatQueryError (TypeScript types)
